document.title: Order to cash: enter a customer order
document.purpose: Document how the sales desk enters a customer order, so the team can agree on it and decide what to automate.
document.scope: From the order e-mail to the order saved in Order Desk and listed in the tracking sheet. Invoicing and delivery are out of scope.
document.trigger: A customer order arrives by e-mail.
document.result: The order is saved in Order Desk and listed in the order tracking sheet.
document.contacts: Process owner: Head of sales operations. SME: Maria Keller, sales assistant. Analyst: the process management team.
document.business_rules: Every order is entered on the day it arrives. A new customer is created before the order. Customers who ask for it get a printed confirmation.
document.exceptions: The wrong customer selected: cancel and search again. The customer's credit is blocked: the order is not entered and the customer is called.
document.effort: About 40 orders a day, 2 to 3 minutes each.
document.improvement: Retire the tracking sheet: the weekly report can read the orders from Order Desk. Keep the new customer check manual.
document.notes: Recorded with Maria at her desk; the orders are test orders in the training copy of Order Desk.
